title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Underwriting Schedule — Late-Charge Share of a Credit Line Increase
content:
A Ridgeline Pro Credit account that has carried late payment charges receives only a share of its credit line increase. The late-charge share is set by the number of late payment charges posted on the account in the late-charge count window:

| Late payment charges posted on the account in the late-charge count window | Late-charge share |
|---|---|
| Exactly one | 0.80 (single-charge share) |
| Two or more | 0.50 (multiple-charge share) |
| None | The increase is granted in full (share of 1) |

## How the share acts

The line increase worked on the current credit line is multiplied by the late-charge share. Where the product of the current credit line and its percentage is multiplied by more than one figure, the multiplications act on that one product, in any order; the share itself is not rounded.

The charges counted are late payment charges posted on the account within the window, counted back from the decision date in whole calendar months.

## Worked cases (hypothetical: current line 40000.00, increase worked at 25 percent, that is 10000.00 before the share)

| Late payment charges in the window | Share | Increase after the share |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 1 | 10000.00 |
| 1 | 0.80 | 8000.00 |
| 2 | 0.50 | 5000.00 |
| 5 | 0.50 | 5000.00 |
